scope.bathymetry_scope: Southern Ocean south of 50 degrees latitude
scope.goal: source-grounded oceanographic learning and control data; independent from frozen seafloor-target gates

source_registry.quality_limits: retrospective NOAA gridded reconstruction; not raw acoustic data; high latitude/sea ice bias; grid may be revised

source_registry.required_before_training: Use bed + TID + RID simultaneously; retain measured vs interpolated distinctions; do not label morphology as artificial structures

source_registry.purpose: raw multibeam bathymetric surveys and instrument calibration
source_registry.access: PUBLIC archive; source-specific surveys require acquisition and instrument metadata
source_registry.required_before_training: survey ID/trackline/raw provenance and native sonar formats
data version, coverage, standalone holdout and daily/monthly definitions

source_registry.access: check product access conditions before fetch
source_registry.required_before_training: select product ID, temporal/spatial subset, license and variables
check per-profile QC flags, depth and time

experiment_preregistration.model: fixed ridge with month dummy, trend, lag-1 and lag-12
experiment_preregistration.evaluation: retrospective rolling one-month horizon; test months held out of weight fitting
experiment_preregistration.success_criterion: RMSE of ridge strictly below seasonal naive RMSE on 2024–2025
experiment_preregistration.promotion: never automatic; blocked until independent replication and modality-specific gates
experiment_preregistration.data_integrity: SHA256 each NetCDF, processed time-series file hash
experiment_preregistration.raw_data_storage: GitHub Actions artifact retention 30 days; authoritative open NOAA copies accessible upstream
experiment_preregistration.processed_data_storage: append-only JSON committed to experiment branch
